MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

2. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 72
   D. 17

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 30

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 38
   C. 88
   D. 19

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

17. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 17
   C. 31
   D. 27

18. Solve for x: x + 6 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 12

19. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 81

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

22. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 10

23. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

24. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
